title: EGI-BENCH: An Enterprise General Intelligence Benchmark Suite
abstract: arXiv:2610.27234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise adoption of LLMs in agentic workflows is gated by evaluations that span a wide arc of abilities: CRM operations, heterogeneous-document retrieval, personal data understanding, multi-turn planning, tool use, function calling, long-horizon research, and long-context software engineering. These evaluations live today in separate repositories with divergent runners, dependencies, and scoring conventions, which makes cross-benchmark comparison difficult and obscures what a single aggregate number actually represents. We release EGI-BENCH, a unified LLM agent benchmark suite that consolidates eight enterprise facing agent benchmarks (CRMARENA, HERB, PERSONABENCH, USERBENCH, MCP-UNIVERSE, MCPEVAL, BENCHFORCE, LOCOBENCH) behind a single command-line interface with two runtime-budgeted execution modes. translated_title: EGI-BENCH：企业通用智能基准测试套件
translated_abstract: 企业在大规模采用大语言模型（LLM）代理工作流时，受到评估体系的制约，这些评估需要覆盖广泛的能力范围：CRM操作、异构文档检索、个人数据理解、多轮规划、工具使用、函数调用、长周期研究以及长上下文软件工程。这些评估目前分散在各自的代码库中，具有不同的运行器、依赖项和评分规范，这使得跨基准比较变得困难，也模糊了单一聚合分数的实际含义。我们发布了EGI-BENCH，这是一个统一的LLM代理基准测试套件，它将八个面向企业的代理基准（CRMARENA、HERB、PERSONABENCH、USERBENCH、MCP-UNIVERSE、MCPEVAL、BENCHFORCE、LOCOBENCH）整合在单一命令行界面之下，并提供两种受运行时预算约束的执行模式。在此套件之上，我们定义了企业通用智能（EGI）分数，这是一个六维框架（M1-M6），其维度涵盖……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: EGI-BENCH是一个统一的LLM代理基准测试套件，将八个面向企业的代理基准整合到单一命令行界面下，并提出了衡量企业通用智能的六维EGI分数框架。
en_tdlr: EGI-BENCH is a unified LLM agent benchmark suite that consolidates eight enterprise-facing agent benchmarks behind a single command-line interface and defines a six-dimensional Enterprise General Intelligence (EGI) Score framework.
